# Ephraim Lifanjo

Ephraim Lifanjo Sewa is a software engineer based in Cameroon. He builds full stack web, mobile and desktop software, designs complex system architectures, integrates payment APIs and Mobile Money, and adds AI, OCR and automation to practical products.

Canonical site: https://ephraimlifanjo.vercel.app/
Toolkit: https://ephraimlifanjo.vercel.app/toolkit/
GitHub: https://github.com/ephraimlifanjo
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ephraim-lifanjo-5b2156329
Dikalo: https://www.dklo.co/profile/696762152
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/ephraim-lifanjo.bsky.social
DEV.to: https://dev.to/ephraim_lifanjo

Core technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C++, React, Next.js, SvelteKit, React Native, Expo, Electron, Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare, Docker, payment APIs, Mobile Money, MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money and AI integration.

Education: GCE Ordinary Level, GCE Advanced Level, Higher National Diploma in Software Engineering at Higher Institute ISMAT, Bachelor of Technology at the University Institute of Technology of Ngaoundéré, Bachelor of Science at Higher Institute ISMAT.

Languages available on the portfolio: English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic and Russian. English is the default when the visitor language is not supported.

Open to: websites, mobile apps, desktop applications, AI systems, payment integrations, hackathons, bootcamps, technology challenges, open source and software architecture collaboration.
